```{r field-retained-bias}
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_H_est2))) {
  ok <- is.finite(rd$bH_or)
  .ret <- function(est) {                        # retained bias vs beta(Hhat), MD units
    d <- est[ok] - rd$bH_or[ok]; d <- d[is.finite(d)]
    c(mean = mean(d), sd_est = stats::sd(d), n = length(d))
  }
  rb_nv <- .ret(rd$nv_H_est); rb_mr <- .ret(rd$mr_H_est); rb_fld <- .ret(rd$fld_H_est2)
  sd_emp_fld <- .sdfin(rd$fld_H_est2); sd_emp_mr <- .sdfin(rd$mr_H_est); sd_emp_nv <- .sdfin(rd$nv_H_est)
  lam_ratio <- .mfin(rd$fld_H_se) / sd_emp_fld
  ij_ratio  <- .mfin(rd$mr_H_se_ij) / sd_emp_mr
  # One-sided lower margins (MD units): field = mr_H_est - lo1s (about beta-tilde); IJ = 1.645 * se_ij.
  marg_fld <- .mfin(rd$mr_H_est - rd$fld_H_lo1s)
  marg_ij  <- .mfin(z95 * rd$mr_H_se_ij)
  hw_fld   <- .mfin((rd$fld_H_hi2s - rd$fld_H_lo2s) / 2)
  hw_ij    <- .mfin((rd$mr_H_hi - rd$mr_H_lo) / 2)
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    quantity = c("naive retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [MD]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [MD]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias vs beta(Hhat)  [MD]",
                 "naive retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "IJ SE / empirical SD  (MR (IJ))",
                 "lambda-SD / empirical SD  (MR (field))",
                 "one-sided LOWER margin, MD: MR (IJ)",
                 "one-sided LOWER margin, MD: MR (field)",
                 "two-sided half-width, MD: MR (IJ)",
                 "two-sided half-width, MD: MR (field)"),
    value = c(rb_nv["mean"], rb_mr["mean"], rb_fld["mean"],
              rb_nv["mean"] / sd_emp_nv, rb_mr["mean"] / sd_emp_mr, rb_fld["mean"] / sd_emp_fld,
              ij_ratio, lam_ratio, marg_ij, marg_fld, hw_ij, hw_fld),
    n = c(rb_nv["n"], rb_mr["n"], rb_fld["n"], rb_nv["n"], rb_mr["n"], rb_fld["n"], rep(NA, 6))),
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Harm block: retained bias against the conditional target beta(Hhat) (MD units and SD units), SE-calibration ratios, one-sided margins and half-widths."))
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    metric = c("outer draws used (mean / min, of R_out = 1000)",
               "inner draws used per outer (mean, of R_in = 500)",
               "field block seconds (mean / median)",
               "replicates with a degenerate field (note set)"),
    value = c(sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_H_nout), suppressWarnings(min(rd$fld_H_nout, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.1f", .mfin(rd$fld_H_nin_mean)),
              sprintf("%.2f / %.2f", .mfin(rd$fld_H_secs), .medfin(rd$fld_H_secs)),
              sprintf("%d of %d detected", sum(!is.na(rd$fld_H_note)), nrow(rd)))),
    caption = "MR (field) Monte Carlo draw usage and cost (detected replicates)."))
}
```

```{r field-reselection}
# Regime diagnostic: p-hat(Hhat), the winner's own re-selection frequency
# (near 1 = settled selection; below ~0.5 = tie regime), and the modal
# candidates across replicates.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$p_hat_H))) {
  ph <- rd$p_hat_H[is.finite(rd$p_hat_H)]
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    metric = c("mean p-hat(Hhat)", "median p-hat(Hhat)", "share p-hat(Hhat) < 0.5 (tie regime)",
               "share p-hat(Hhat) >= 0.9 (settled)", "mean top-1 p-hat",
               "share of replicates where the winner IS the modal candidate"),
    value = c(mean(ph), stats::median(ph), mean(ph < 0.5), mean(ph >= 0.9),
              .mfin(rd$p_top1), mean(rd$p_hat_H == rd$p_top1, na.rm = TRUE))), digits = 3,
    caption = "Re-selection frequencies (return_reselection = TRUE), detected replicates."))
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(p_hat_bin = cut(ph, c(0, .25, .5, .75, .9, 1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
          table() |> as.data.frame() |> setNames(c("p_hat(Hhat) bin", "n")),
        caption = "Distribution of p-hat(Hhat)."))
}
```

```{r field-complement-diagnostics}
# Complement field block: retained bias against beta(Hhat^c) (MD and SD units),
# the complement's lambda-SD/SD and IJ-SE/SD, the one-sided UPPER margins and
# half-widths beside IJ's, the regime diagnostics SD(beta-tilde^c)/naive SE and
# lambda-SD^c/naive SE, and the complement-fit accounting and cost.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_Hc_est2))) {
  okc <- is.finite(rd$bHc_or)
  .retc <- function(est) { d <- est[okc] - rd$bHc_or[okc]; d <- d[is.finite(d)]
    c(mean = mean(d), sd_est = stats::sd(d), n = length(d)) }
  rbc_nv <- .retc(rd$nv_Hc_est); rbc_mr <- .retc(rd$mr_Hc_est); rbc_fld <- .retc(rd$fld_Hc_est2)
  sdc_fld <- .sdfin(rd$fld_Hc_est2); sdc_mr <- .sdfin(rd$mr_Hc_est); sdc_nv <- .sdfin(rd$nv_Hc_est)
  nv_se_c <- .mfin(rd$nv_Hc_se)
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    quantity = c("naive retained bias vs beta(Hhat^c)  [MD]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias vs beta(Hhat^c)  [MD]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias vs beta(Hhat^c)  [MD]",
                 "naive retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "MR (IJ) retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "MR (field) est2 retained bias  [SD units]",
                 "IJ SE / empirical SD  (MR (IJ), complement)",
                 "lambda-SD / empirical SD  (MR (field), complement)",
                 "REGIME: SD(beta-tilde^c) / naive SE",
                 "REGIME: lambda-SD^c / naive SE",
                 "one-sided UPPER margin, MD: MR (IJ)",
                 "one-sided UPPER margin, MD: MR (field)",
                 "two-sided half-width, MD: MR (IJ)",
                 "two-sided half-width, MD: MR (field)"),
    value = c(rbc_nv["mean"], rbc_mr["mean"], rbc_fld["mean"],
              rbc_nv["mean"] / sdc_nv, rbc_mr["mean"] / sdc_mr, rbc_fld["mean"] / sdc_fld,
              .mfin(rd$mr_Hc_se_ij) / sdc_mr, .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_se) / sdc_fld,
              sdc_mr / nv_se_c, .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_se) / nv_se_c,
              .mfin(z95 * rd$mr_Hc_se_ij), .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_up1s - rd$mr_Hc_est),
              .mfin((rd$mr_Hc_hi - rd$mr_Hc_lo) / 2), .mfin((rd$fld_Hc_hi2s - rd$fld_Hc_lo2s) / 2)),
    n = c(rbc_nv["n"], rbc_mr["n"], rbc_fld["n"], rbc_nv["n"], rbc_mr["n"], rbc_fld["n"], rep(NA, 8))),
    digits = 4,
    caption = "Complement Hhat^c: retained bias against beta(Hhat^c), SE-calibration ratios, regime diagnostics, one-sided upper margins and half-widths (MD units)."))
  print(knitr::kable(data.frame(
    metric = c("outer draws used (mean / min, of R_out = 1000)",
               "inner draws used per outer (mean, of R_in = 500)",
               "distinct complement fits per replicate (mean / max)",
               "share of draw-winner readings needing a new complement fit (mean / max)",
               "complement field block seconds (mean / median)",
               "replicates with a degenerate complement field (note set)"),
    value = c(sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nout), suppressWarnings(min(rd$fld_Hc_nout, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.1f", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nin_mean)),
              sprintf("%.1f / %d", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_nfit), suppressWarnings(max(rd$fld_Hc_nfit, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.3f / %.3f", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_share_newfit), suppressWarnings(max(rd$fld_Hc_share_newfit, na.rm = TRUE))),
              sprintf("%.2f / %.2f", .mfin(rd$fld_Hc_secs), .medfin(rd$fld_Hc_secs)),
              sprintf("%d of %d detected", sum(!is.na(rd$fld_Hc_note)), nrow(rd)))),
    caption = "Complement field: Monte Carlo draw usage, complement-fit accounting and cost (detected replicates)."))
}
```

```{r field-bias-coverage-complement}
#| fig-width: 13

# Complement display (block Hc, side upper, identity scale): one point per
# estimator against the Gaussian reference Phi(1.645 r + b) for the UPPER bound.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_Hc_est2))) {
  .ests_Hc <- if (isTRUE(show_winner_rows) && any(is.finite(results$mr_Hc_se_w)))
    c("mr", "mr_w", "mr_wf", "fld") else c("mr", "fld")
  bcc <- fs_sim_bias_coverage(res_or, block = "Hc", estimators = .ests_Hc, side = "upper", scale = "identity")
  bcc$cell <- cell_lab
  print(knitr::kable(bcc[, c("cell", "estimator", "n", "bias_log", "sd_emp", "se_mean", "b", "r",
                             "cov1", "cov2", "cov1_ref", "cov2_ref")], digits = 3,
    caption = "Bias vs coverage, complement block (one-sided = UPPER bound; identity scale): bias_log = retained bias vs beta(Hhat^c) in MD units; b, r as above; *_ref = Gaussian bookkeeping prediction at (b, r)."))
  print(fs_plot_bias_coverage(bcc, side = "upper"))
```

```{r field-joint-pair}
# Simultaneous (H lower, Hc upper) pair: joint coverage of
# (beta(Hhat) >= lower_H AND beta(Hhat^c) <= upper_Hc) for (i) the separate 95%
# field bounds, (ii) the Bonferroni pair, (iii) the calibrated pair; margins
# in MD units from the two-term de-biased estimates.
if (nrow(rd) && any(is.finite(rd$fld_joint_gamma))) {
  rJ <- rd[is.finite(rd$bH_or) & is.finite(rd$bHc_or) & is.finite(rd$fld_joint_gamma), , drop = FALSE]
  .wl <- function(x, n) { w <- .wilson(x, n); sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", x, w[1], w[2]) }
  pairs <- list(
    `separate 95% field bounds` = list(lo = rJ$fld_H_lo1s, up = rJ$fld_Hc_up1s),
    `Bonferroni (gamma = 0.025)` = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_bonf_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_bonf_upHc),
    `calibrated gamma`           = list(lo = rJ$fld_joint_loH, up = rJ$fld_joint_upHc))
  jt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pairs), function(nm) {
    p <- pairs[[nm]]
    covH <- rJ$bH_or >= p$lo; covC <- rJ$bHc_or <= p$up
    data.frame(pair = nm, n = nrow(rJ), joint_cov = .wl(mean(covH & covC), nrow(rJ)),
               cov_H = mean(covH), cov_Hc = mean(covC),
               margin_H = mean(rJ$mr_H_est - p$lo), margin_Hc = mean(p$up - rJ$mr_Hc_est),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  print(knitr::kable(jt, digits = 3,
    caption = sprintf("Joint (Hhat lower, Hhat^c upper) coverage of (beta(Hhat), beta(Hhat^c)) with Wilson intervals; margins in MD units from the two-term de-biased estimates. Mean gamma = %.4f (achieved joint prob. %.3f; Bonferroni %.3f); mean corr(Lambda*, Lambda*c) = %+.3f; n_joint_draws mean %.0f.",
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_gamma), mean(rJ$fld_joint_prob), mean(rJ$fld_joint_bonf_prob),
                      mean(rJ$fld_joint_corr), mean(rJ$fld_joint_n))))
}
```

```{r identification-figures}
if (nrow(rd)) {
  rule_covs <- function(rule) forestsearch:::.fs_rule_columns(rule)
  cov_list  <- lapply(rd$sg_def, rule_covs)
  cov_all   <- unique(unlist(cov_list))
  if (length(cov_all)) {
    cf <- vapply(cov_all, function(v)
      mean(vapply(cov_list, function(x) v %in% x, logical(1))), numeric(1))
    cf_df <- data.frame(covariate = names(cf), share = unname(cf))
    cf_df$true_region <- cf_df$covariate %in% c("age", "preanti")
    print(
      ggplot(cf_df, aes(x = reorder(covariate, share), y = share, fill = true_region)) +
        geom_col() + coord_flip() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                          labels = c(`TRUE` = "true-region covariate", `FALSE` = "other"), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of detected replicates selecting the covariate",
             title = "Selected-covariate frequencies",
             subtitle = "True harm region: age > 34 & preanti <= 744.5 (z1 = z2 = 1)") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
    rules <- sort(table(rd$sg_def), decreasing = TRUE)
    knitr::kable(data.frame(rule = names(rules), n = as.integer(rules),
                            share = as.numeric(rules) / nrow(rd)),
      digits = 3, caption = "Realized rules (sg_def) by frequency, detected reps.")

}
```

# Timing {#sec-timing}

```{r timing-distributions}
.dist_row <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(rep(NA_real_, 14))
  c(min = min(x), stats::quantile(x, probs = seq(0.1, 0.9, 0.1)),
    median = stats::median(x), mean = mean(x), max = max(x), n = length(x))
}
tim <- rbind(fit_mr_secs = .dist_row(results$fit_mr_secs),
             fld_H_secs  = .dist_row(results$fld_H_secs),
             fld_Hc_secs = .dist_row(results$fld_Hc_secs))
knitr::kable(tim, digits = 2,
  caption = sprintf("Per-replicate seconds (all replicates; %s mode, %d workers). fit_mr_secs INCLUDES the field blocks.",
                    parallel_mode, n_workers))
```

```{r timing-projection}
# Scale-up projection: measured per-replicate cost drives a busiest-worker wall
# model, calibrated by k = measured wall / modelled wall on THIS run.
mr_mean <- .mfin(results$fit_mr_secs)
fmt_hm <- function(sec) {
  if (!is.finite(sec)) return("-")
  h <- floor(sec / 3600); m <- round((sec - 3600 * h) / 60)
  if (h >= 1) sprintf("%d h %02d m", h, m) else sprintf("%d m", round(sec / 60))
}
wall_model <- function(ns) ceiling(ns / n_workers) * mr_mean
k_cal <- if (is.finite(elapsed) && wall_model(n_batch) > 0) elapsed / wall_model(n_batch) else NA_real_
proj <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(n_batch, 1000L, 2000L), function(ns)
  data.frame(n_sims = ns, per_rep_s = round(mr_mean, 2), cpu_hours = round(ns * mr_mean / 3600, 2),
             wall_model = fmt_hm(wall_model(ns)),
             wall_calibrated = fmt_hm(if (is.finite(k_cal)) k_cal * wall_model(ns) else NA_real_))))
proj$wall_actual <- c(fmt_hm(elapsed), "-", "-")
cat(sprintf("This run: %d reps in %s on %d workers; per rep fit+MR(+field) %.2f s%s.\n",
            n_batch, if (is.finite(elapsed)) sprintf("%.0f s", elapsed) else "- (combine)", n_workers, mr_mean,
            if (is.finite(k_cal)) sprintf("; realized overhead factor k = %.2f", k_cal) else ""))
knitr::kable(proj, caption = "Wall-clock projection: ceil(sims / workers) x per-rep cost, and k x that.")
```

```{r session-info}
.fmt_dur <- function(s) {
  h <- s %/% 3600; m <- (s %% 3600) %/% 60; sec <- round(s %% 60)
  if (h >= 1) sprintf("%d h %02d m %02d s", h, m, sec)
  else if (m >= 1) sprintf("%d m %02d s", m, sec)
  else sprintf("%.1f s", s)
}
.secs_total <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t0_doc, units = "secs"))
cat(sprintf("TOTAL wall-clock, start to finish: %s  (= %.0f s; %d reps on %d workers)\n",
            .fmt_dur(.secs_total), .secs_total, n_batch, n_workers))
if (is.finite(elapsed)) cat(sprintf("  of which the run loop: %s\n", .fmt_dur(elapsed)))
sessionInfo()
```
